labeller: agent (exp15 session), from matcher_cjk_audit_readouts.json only; the matcher's output was not looked at before labelling
rule: Same rule as matcher_audit_labels.json: a colour c in {red, blue, green, gold, pink, gray, brown, black, white, purple} is named if the readout uses c's name (English or Chinese, any case; 'golden' = gold, 'grey' = gray) to refer to a colour or a colour-named state. A colour word inside a non-colour name does not count (e.g. 'Gray Wolf' / 灰狼, 'blueberry'). Colours outside the 10 (yellow / 黄, orange) are ignored.
